summary:
Fixed the silent truncation in [src/main.rs](/app/src/main.rs:12). `process_file` now reads the full input with `read_to_end()` instead of doing a single 64 KB `read()`.

Verified:
- `PATH=/app/target/release:$PATH ./test.sh` passes: output size `102400` matches input.
- `cargo test` passes: `3 passed`.

Note: plain `./test.sh` was picking up the older `/usr/local/bin/fileproc`, so I rebuilt and ran the script with the patched binary first on `PATH`.
